main_theorem_contract: F_(m,s) is a polynomial symplectomorphism of K^4.
The actual q-degree orbit of the ordinary seed u_0=(1,1)^T switches strictly between the two chambers r=u_1/u_2<2 and r>2.
The selected first-phase matrices are A_-, A_+, and B_m=diag(2m+1,m).
Writing C_-=s B_m A_-, C_+=s B_m A_+, and P=(B_m A_+)(B_m A_-), the exact parity formulas are u_(2j)=(s^2 P)^j (1,1)^T and u_(2j+1)=s B_m A_- (s^2 P)^j (1,1)^T.
For every n>=1, the first position coordinate is strictly maximal among all four coordinate degrees, hence d_n=deg(F_(m,s)^n)=u_(n,1), with d_0=1 as the tied seed.
The two eigenvalues of P are H=m^2(2m+1)^2 and L=2m(m+1), so lambda_1(F_(m,s))=s m(2m+1).
The visible degree sequence satisfies d_(n+4)=s^2(H+L)d_(n+2)-s^4 H L d_n with d_0=1, d_1=2m(2m+1)s, d_2=2m(m+1)(2m-1)(2m+1)s^2, and d_3=8m^4(m+1)(2m+1)s^3.
The exact wall gaps are u_(2j,1)-2u_(2j,2)=-(s^2 L)^j and u_(2j+1,1)-2u_(2j+1,2)=2m s (s^2 L)^j.
Inside the crossed-binomial / diagonal-pure-power ansatz, strict chamber exchange forces e/f=R(L_wall-1)/(L_wall-R).
The abstract period-k selector-to-monodromy statement is valid only as a conditional technique lemma with explicit selector, carry, noncancellation, linearity, and visibility hypotheses.

lemmas.statement: The displayed gradient shears have subtraction inverses and preserve the standard symplectic form by symmetric Hessian blocks.
Literal differentiation yields the four frozen gradient coordinates and the two synchronized first-phase row differences.
The common wall r=2 gives exactly A_-, A_+, B_m, C_-, and C_+ with the frozen phase order.
The corrected h_m and ell_m difference identities exchange both open chambers strictly and exclude the wall.
The base seed carry and both later chamberwise first-phase and second-phase carry inequalities hold already at s=1.
Unique strict sources and the domain rule for top homogeneous parts prevent cancellation for arbitrary nonzero A,B,C,D in characteristic zero.
q_1 dominates q_2 and both final momentum degrees at every positive iterate; d_0 is the tied seed.
The strict period-two itinerary yields the displayed P, H and L eigenpairs, and lambda_1=s*m*(2m+1).
The determinant identity is proved by an explicit expansion or determinant multiplicativity, not merely stated.
Cayley-Hamilton yields the stride-two scalar recurrence, exact initials, and corrected u_3.
The left wall functional gives the exact alternating wall gaps and proves the orbit never lands on the wall.
The even vector decomposition and odd visible formula give exact parity laws, while integrality follows from integer matrices and recurrence.
Within the crossed-binomial and diagonal-pure-power ansatz, synchronous wall exchange occurs iff e/f=R(L_wall-1)/(L_wall-R).
The explicit m,s family realizes exactly R=2, L_wall=2m+2, and (e,f)=s(2m+1,m), with carry and visibility proved separately.
The conditional period-k monodromy statement requires all six strict-selection, carry, domain, linearity, degree-visibility, and Perron-visibility hypotheses.
All boundary, citation, collision, anti-claim, zero-science, inventory, and permission locks remain conjunctive.
